A SMALL RULE. AN ENDLESS GAME.

Follow the numbers.

  1. Look at the latest tiles.

    “Precedents” means the last numbers played along your path. The starting digits are given; change them with “Start a new path.”

  2. Work out the next digit.

    In Sum of 2, add the last two: 8 + 7 = 15, so place 5. Sum of 3 uses three digits. Multiply uses the last two: 7 × 8 = 56, so place 6.

  3. Choose a digit, then an open hex.

    The new tile must share a side with the latest tile. You can turn in any direction, but you can’t reuse an occupied hex. Other neighboring tiles don’t affect the calculation.

  4. Keep growing.

    There’s no timer or fixed edge. If you circle yourself in, undo a move and find another way. Multiplication can reach 0; continuing with zeros is valid.

Keyboard shortcuts0–9 select · Z undo · H hint · C center · +/− zoom · arrows panTab to a highlighted hex, then press Enter to place.
